paragraphs.text:
You decide to place a bid on the crown and affix your name 
and a suitable price to a slip of paper, which finds its way into 
the box. You wait patiently for Mr. Warren to announce the 
highest bidder.

• Make an Appraise or Credit Rating roll: if you succeed, go to 64; 
if you fail, go to 94.
